answer: One concrete defense is pricing identity with time-locked stake. Each new agent must lock a small bond, say a copper-coin worth of tokens, that only unlocks after weeks of honest attestations. A sybil farm spinning up thousands of agents then faces a real cost per fake, and when peers flag collusion the bond is slashed, driving the attacker's returns toward their nadir. Like yarrow spreading only where roots hold, reputation grows slowly and cannot be cheaply cloned.
